problems.title: Four daily burdens for hospitals and doctors

items.description: Dozens of readings a day, quality swings when doctors get tired.
items.solution: Initial screening comes out in under 2 seconds on average, consistent every time.

items.title: Every AI tool has its own app
items.description: Staff switch apps and log in repeatedly, a new module means a new procurement.
items.solution: Every module lives in one platform, one account, one workflow.

items.title: Audit and compliance take time
items.description: Tracing who checked what and when is still manual.
items.solution: Every data mutation is logged automatically and ready to trace.

items.title: Fear that AI disrupts an existing workflow
items.description: Integrations are often long, expensive, and change clinic habits.
items.solution: Complements the running system, doctors still make the call.

items.question: What is PRECIA?
items.answer: PRECIA is a clinical AI platform for hospitals and clinics. We run several AI screening modules (currently AI-ECG, AI-BOO Multimodal, and AI-DU) in one system, with the doctor as the final decision-maker and every action logged to the audit trail.

items.question: How does PRECIA's AI-ECG work?
items.answer: AI-ECG analyzes an uploaded 12-lead ECG image and classifies the result as Normal or Abnormal, as an indicator of possible low Ejection Fraction, along with a confidence score and a reading guide. This module is live in PRECIA production.

items.question: Does the AI result replace a doctor's decision?
items.answer: No. Every PRECIA AI module is a screening decision-support tool, not a replacement for clinical diagnosis. For cases with an abnormal indication, confirmation via standard clinical examination is still required.

items.question: How long does an AI screening result take?
items.answer: For a standard request, AI-ECG and AI-BOO results typically come back in under 2 seconds on average (based on internal testing, 20 runs per module, 20/20 successful). It can take longer under heavy server load.

items.question: Does PRECIA have BPOM/Ministry of Health regulatory clearance?
items.answer: Not yet. We're transparent about this because it matters for your clinical decisions. Our AI modules are pilot-stage and being trialed with partner institutions. Contact us at contact@precia.site for the current status.

items.question: Which AI modules are available today?
items.answer: AI-ECG (EF Screening) for cardiology, AI-BOO Multimodal and AI-DU (Detrusor Underactivity) for urology are live on our platform. AI-Ortho is in development. New modules are added based on what partner hospitals and clinics need.

items.question: What's being developed next?
items.answer: One research direction is underway: screening for mitral valve disease (regurgitation/stenosis) from the same ECG images used by AI-ECG. Still research/pilot stage — a research model exists but hasn't been wrapped into a production service yet. We're transparent about the stage because it matters for your clinical decisions.

items.question: Can PRECIA connect to the SIMRS my hospital already uses?
items.answer: We've tested the integration path end-to-end with SIMRS Khanza, MEDICCA, and Open Hospital in our test environment. PRECIA doesn't replace your SIMRS, it complements it: patient data flows in automatically, AI results flow back to the system you already use. Using a different SIMRS? Talk to our team about your needs.
